name: n8n
description: n8n workflow automation — full Public API v1 coverage: workflows (versions, publish, archive), executions, credentials, tags, variables, users, projects, folders, data tables, test runs, community packages, audit, insights, source control, instance settings and package export/import.

settings.label: n8n URL
settings.help: Base URL of the n8n instance, e.g. https://n8n.example.com — no trailing slash, /api/v1 is added automatically.

settings.label: API key
settings.help: n8n → Settings → n8n API → Create an API key.

settings.label: CF-Access-Client-Id
settings.help: Optional Cloudflare Access service token ID (ends in .access). Only needed when the instance sits behind Cloudflare Access; set both CF fields or neither.

settings.label: CF-Access-Client-Secret
settings.help: Optional Cloudflare Access service token secret — sent as the CF-Access-Client-Secret header on every request when set.
